subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this maintainer-authored prompt-guidance branch be closed as superseded by current main, or rebased into the current sub-agent prompt architecture?
rationale: The useful delegation idea is mostly represented on current main, but the protected maintainer label and model-facing prompt-policy surface require owner intent before cleanup closure or consolidation.

options.title: Close as superseded after owner check
options.body: Current main already has richer sub-agent orchestration and tool-description guidance, so close this branch if no unique policy remains.

options.title: Rebase and consolidate
options.body: Keep the PR only if the desired wording is folded into existing helpers and the duplicate Tooling rubric plus absolute nested-spawn ban are removed.

options.title: Defer to narrower Codex steering
options.body: Leave generic core prompt policy alone and handle Codex-app-server steering in the narrower related PR if maintainers still want that behavior.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded after owner check
recommendation.body: Current main already has richer sub-agent orchestration and tool-description guidance, so close this branch if no unique policy remains.

likelyOwner.reason: Current prompt/tool-description blame and sessions_spawn history make this the strongest available owner for prompt-policy direction.
